title: On-call agent response
description: What the headless agent must return. Validated by responder.py before any policy check.

root_cause.description: The defect, with file and line, and why it only hits some requests.

evidence_used.description: Which evidence.json entries (metric, log line, trace id, commit) support the root cause.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths the agent edited (POSIX separators).

tests_added.description: Test node ids that reproduce the failure, e.g. backend/tests/unit/test_x.py::test_y.

confidence.description: 0..1, how sure the agent is that the change fixes the user impact.

summary.description: One paragraph for the PR body and the incident report.
